question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Abode of Love’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mr. __****__Narendra Modi.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Abode of Love" is written by the Indian Prime Minister Mr. Narendra Modi.**
 
• It was published in **2018.**
 
• Narendra Modi is the** 14th and current Prime Minister of India.** He is the first prime minister born in independent India.
 
• He is the second prime minister to visit the Siachin glacier.
 
• His administration** revoked the special status of Jammu and Kashmir in 2019.**
 
• He was honored with the** "Order of the Distinguished Rule of Izzuddin"**(The highest honor of the Maldives awarded to foreign dignitaries) in **2019**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
